name: gauntlet
description: Run a Gauntlet Loop from the terminal: builders iterate against blind critics until the work beats a captured bar twice in a row.

scripts.build:plugin: node -e "import('./dist/plugin-dir.js').then(async (m) => { const { cpSync, existsSync, mkdirSync } = await import('node:fs'); const { dirname, join, resolve } = await import('node:path'); const from = resolve('..'); const to = resolve('dist', m.PACKAGED_PLUGIN_SUBDIR); for (const rel of Object.values(m.PLUGIN_FILES)) { const src = join(from, rel); if (!existsSync(src)) continue; const dst = join(to, rel); mkdirSync(dirname(dst), { recursive: true }); cpSync(src, dst); } const license = join(from, 'LICENSE'); if (existsSync(license)) cpSync(license, resolve('LICENSE')); })"
